title: Malicious SHA-256 file hash fe06eb908f0b… (OffSeq Mirage)
description: A malicious file identified by the SHA-256 hash fe06eb908f0b5c042ea623f4e30e822d498b1b410862528b9df59ca52a57e837 was observed by OffSeq Mirage honeypot sensors on 2026-10-30. This file was seen four times in attacker activity involving the T1105 technique (Ingress Tool Transfer) from attacker infrastructure located in Bulgaria. The file hash corresponds to a specific malicious payload, which could be a dropper, web shell, miner, or post-exploitation tool. Organizations are advised to check their environments and security tools for this hash to detect potential compromise.
